_note: 2026-10-10 (CLAUDE.md §53). Real screenshots of the live Atlantis system (portal.atlantisndt.com, the ERP back office, the Atlantis LMS and practice.atlantisndt.com), captured read-only from the owner's signed-in browser. Client names, project names, job numbers, locations and inspector names are blurred in the image itself; nothing was edited in the system. One source for both layers: React src/components/ProductScreenshotsBlock.tsx and crawler scripts/product-screenshots.mjs. Rules: captions describe only what the image shows; no numerals in any caption, alt or heading (software copy rule); every image is a real capture, never a mock-up.

client-portal-home.alt: Atlantis client portal home page with orders, invoices, courses, Practical NDT and Digital Twin Reporting
client-portal-home.caption: The client portal: orders and invoices, enrolled courses, and links into Practical NDT and Digital Twin Reporting from the same login.

erp-ndt-report-workflow.alt: Ultrasonic testing report record in Atlantis ERP showing the draft, in progress, under review, approved and sent to client workflow
erp-ndt-report-workflow.caption: An ultrasonic testing report record: template, method, dates, procedure and code references, with the Draft, In Progress, Under Review, Approved and Sent to Client workflow and Excel or PDF output. Client and project details blurred.

erp-inspection-reports-list.alt: Inspection reports list in Atlantis ERP with report numbers, methods, results and status
erp-inspection-reports-list.caption: Every inspection report in one list, numbered by method, with its overall result and where it sits in review. Project and inspector names blurred.

lms-courses-dashboard.alt: Atlantis LMS course dashboard with course progress, Level I courses, learner rank and badges
lms-courses-dashboard.caption: The Atlantis LMS: enrolled courses with progress, the course catalogue by level, and learner ranks and badges.

practical-ndt-academy.alt: Practical NDT academy screen for choosing a training workplace such as an oil and gas site, pipeline, storage tank or heat exchanger
practical-ndt-academy.caption: Practical NDT starts with a workplace: process plant, pipeline, storage tank, heat exchanger, offshore, aviation and the NDT lab, then a method and technique.

practical-ndt-paut-workstation.alt: Practical NDT guided phased array sectorial scan practical with flaw detector, couplant, weld specimen and procedure checklist
practical-ndt-paut-workstation.caption: A guided phased array (PAUT) sectorial-scan practical: set the equipment up on the bench while the procedure checklist tracks each step. A training simulation, not a validated engineering tool.

practical-ndt-mfl-tank-floor.alt: Practical NDT magnetic flux leakage tank floor practice with the MFL scanner, live trace and estimated wall-loss C-scan
practical-ndt-mfl-tank-floor.caption: Tank-floor practice with an MFL scanner: live MFL trace and an estimated wall-loss C-scan. The reference overlay shown is a teaching display, not inspection evidence.

practical-ndt-tank-cutaway.alt: Practical NDT teaching cutaway of a storage tank with the MFL scanner on the floor
practical-ndt-tank-cutaway.caption: A teaching cutaway of the storage tank, with the shell opened so the learner can follow the scanner across the floor.
